jyutping: jau4 dung1 min6 ceoi1 lai4 ge3 N

english.note: Use this before 風 or another noun when it is blowing or coming from the east.

examples.english: The wind blowing from the east is quite strong today.
examples.traditional: 由東面吹嚟嘅風今日幾大。
